cohort: 305 mother-infant pairs from seven European countries
finding: Subclinical mastitis (SCM) is associated with significant changes in the macro- and micronutrient composition of human milk (HM), but no differences in infant growth and HM intake were observed between non-SCM and SCM groups.
mod_finding: The study found that birth by C-section was higher in mothers with subclinical mastitis (SCM).
